commands.name: #P
commands.description: Stores how many payments to amortise (1 to 1,200) and works out that schedule; the next one starts where it left off.

commands.name: #T(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: how many times flow n of the named CFLO list occurs.

commands.name: #T?
commands.description: Turns on or off the prompt asking how often each flow repeats.
Percent: after an operator, takes that percentage of the number before it (200 + 5 % adds 5% of 200); alone, divides the number by 100.

commands.name: %CH
commands.description: The change from OLD to NEW as a percentage of OLD. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: %CHG
commands.description: Percent change: the menu of OLD, NEW and %CH.

commands.name: %T
commands.description: PART as a percentage of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: %TOTL
commands.description: Percent of total: the menu of TOTAL, PART and %T.
Opens a parenthesis, so the part inside is worked out first.
Closes a parenthesis opened with (.
Adds the next number to the one before it.
Changes the sign of the number being keyed in or of the result shown.

commands.name: +HR
commands.description: Moves the clock one hour forward.

commands.name: +MIN
commands.description: Moves the clock one minute forward.

commands.name: +SEC
commands.description: Moves the clock one second forward.

commands.name: , (DSP)
commands.description: Shows numbers with a decimal comma and periods between groups of digits: 1.234,50.

commands.name: -HR
commands.description: Moves the clock one hour back.

commands.name: -MIN
commands.description: Moves the clock one minute back.

commands.name: -SEC
commands.description: Moves the clock one second back.

commands.name: . (DSP)
commands.description: Shows numbers with a decimal point and commas between groups of digits: 1,234.50.

commands.name: 1/x
commands.description: The reciprocal of the number shown.

commands.name: 10^X
commands.description: 10 raised to the power of the number shown.
Switches between the 12-hour and the 24-hour clock.
Uses the 30/360 calendar (twelve 30-day months).

commands.name: 360D
commands.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 counted with 30-day months and a 360-day year.

commands.name: 365D
commands.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 on a 365-day calendar, ignoring leap days.
Finishes the calculation on the calculator line and shows the result.

commands.name: A/A
commands.description: Uses the actual/actual calendar.

commands.name: A/PM (APPT)
commands.description: Switches the appointment's time from AM to PM or back (12-hour clock).

commands.name: A/PM (SET)
commands.description: Switches the clock between AM and PM.

commands.name: ABS(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x without its sign.

commands.name: ACCRU
commands.description: Interest accrued since the last coupon date up to settlement, per 100 of face value.

commands.name: ACRS
commands.description: The ACRS deduction: BASIS times ACRS%.

commands.name: ACRS%
commands.description: The ACRS percentage from the published tables.

commands.name: ADJST
commands.description: Opens the menu that moves the clock forward or back by an hour, a minute or a second.

commands.name: ALL
commands.description: Shows numbers with as many digits as they need, up to 12.

commands.name: ALOG(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 10 to the power x.

commands.name: AMRT
commands.description: Opens the amortisation menu, which splits payments into interest and principal and shows the balance.

commands.name: AND
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when both sides are true.

commands.name: ANN
commands.description: Coupons are paid once a year.

commands.name: APPT
commands.description: Opens the ten appointments, with which are set and which are overdue.

commands.name: APT1
commands.description: Opens an appointment (APT1 to APT5 here, APT6 to APT10 under MORE) to set or see its date, time, message and repeat.

commands.name: B
commands.description: The B coefficient of the chosen model; the y-intercept for the linear one.

commands.name: BAL
commands.description: What is left of the loan after the amortised payments.

commands.name: BASIS
commands.description: What the asset cost when it was bought: its depreciable basis.

commands.name: BEEP
commands.description: Steps through the beeper settings: on, on for appointments only, off.

commands.name: BEG
commands.description: Begin mode: payments come at the start of each period, as with leases and savings plans.

commands.name: BOND
commands.description: Bond price and yield on any date: coupons once or twice a year, on a 30/360 or an actual/actual calendar.

commands.name: BUS
commands.description: Opens the business percentage menus: %CHG, %TOTL, MU%C, MU%P.

commands.name: CALC (CFLO)
commands.description: Opens the CFLO CALC menu: TOTAL, IRR%, I%, NPV, NUS, NFV for the current list.

commands.name: CALC (SOLVE)
commands.description: Checks the current equation and makes a menu of its variables, to store values and solve for any one of them.

commands.name: CALC (SUM)
commands.description: Opens the statistics of the current SUM list: total, mean, median, deviation, range, and FRCST for two lists.

commands.name: CALC (TIME)
commands.description: Opens date arithmetic: the day of the week, days between dates, a date some days away.

commands.name: CALL
commands.description: The call price per 100 of face value; 100 for a yield to maturity.

commands.name: CDATE
commands.description: In an equation: today's date, from the clock.

commands.name: CFLO
commands.description: Cash flows: lists of uneven cash flows for net present value, internal rate of return and more.

commands.name: CLEAR DATA
commands.description: Clears the data of the menu on display: the variables of a menu such as TVM, the list in SUM or CFLO, or (in SOLVE) all equations after asking. From MAIN it clears the history stack.

commands.name: CLR
commands.description: Clears the calculator line. Pressed while the calculator is off, it turns it on.

commands.name: CONT
commands.description: Continuous compounding: the menu of NOM% and EFF%.

commands.name: CORR
commands.description: The correlation coefficient, from −1 to +1: how well the chosen model fits the two lists.

commands.name: COST (MU%C)
commands.description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%C.

commands.name: COST (MU%P)
commands.description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%P.

commands.name: CPN%
commands.description: The yearly coupon rate in percent.

commands.name: CTIME
commands.description: In an equation: the time now, from the clock.

commands.name: DATE (APPT)
commands.description: Sets the appointment's date to the date shown.

commands.name: DATE (SET)
commands.description: Sets the date to the number shown (MM.DDYYYY or DD.MMYYYY).

commands.name: DATE(d1:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the date n days after d1 (before it when n is negative), in the date format set in TIME SET.

commands.name: DATE1
commands.description: The first date: stores the date shown (with its day of the week) or works it out from DATE2 and DAYS.

commands.name: DATE2
commands.description: The second date: stores the date shown or works it out from DATE1 and DAYS.

commands.name: DAY
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many days (the number shown).

commands.name: DAYS
commands.description: The actual number of days from DATE1 to DATE2, leap years counted. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: DB
commands.description: The declining-balance depreciation for year YR#; ▼ then shows the remaining depreciable value.

commands.name: DDAYS(d1:d2:cal)
commands.description: In an equation: the days from d1 to d2 on calendar cal: 1 actual, 2 the 365-day year, 3 the 360-day year.

commands.name: DELET (CFLO)
commands.description: Deletes the flow shown.

commands.name: DELET (SOLVE)
commands.description: Deletes the current equation, or only its variables.

commands.name: DELET (SUM)
commands.description: Deletes the item shown.

commands.name: DEPRC
commands.description: Depreciation by declining balance, sum of the years' digits, straight line or ACRS.

commands.name: DSP
commands.description: Opens the DSP menu to set how numbers are shown: decimal places and the radix mark.

commands.name: E
commands.description: Starts the exponent of a number in scientific notation: 6 E 3 is 6,000.

commands.name: EDIT
commands.description: Opens the current equation in the ALPHA-Edit menu to change it.

commands.name: EFF% (CONT)
commands.description: The effective yearly rate in percent of continuous compounding. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM%.

commands.name: EFF% (PER)
commands.description: The effective yearly rate in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM% and P.

commands.name: END
commands.description: End mode: each payment comes at the close of its period, as with most loans.

commands.name: EXIT
commands.description: Goes back to the previous menu.

commands.name: EXP
commands.description: e raised to the power of the number shown.

commands.name: EXP (FRCST)
commands.description: Fits an exponential curve, y = B·e^(M·x).

commands.name: EXP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: e to the power x.

commands.name: EXPM1(x)
commands.description: In an equation: e to the power x, less 1, exact for small x.

commands.name: FACT%
commands.description: The declining-balance rate, in percent of the straight-line rate (200 for double declining balance).

commands.name: FACT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the factorial of a whole number x.

commands.name: FIN
commands.description: Opens the finance menus: TVM, ICNV, CFLO, BOND, DEPRC.

commands.name: FIRST
commands.description: The first payment of the table to print.

commands.name: FIX
commands.description: Sets how many decimal places numbers show: type 0 to 11, then INPUT.

commands.name: FLOW(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: flow number n of the named CFLO list.

commands.name: FP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the fractional part of x.

commands.name: FRCST
commands.description: Two-list statistics: asks for the x list and the y list, then opens the menu for curve fitting, forecasts, weighted mean and summations.

commands.name: FV
commands.description: The future value: the amount at the close of the last period. Money paid out is negative.

commands.name: G.SD
commands.description: The standard deviation of the x values grouped by the frequencies in the y list.

commands.name: GET (CFLO)
commands.description: Switches to another named cash-flow list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

commands.name: GET (SUM)
commands.description: Switches to another named SUM list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

commands.name: GO
commands.description: Prints the amortisation table from FIRST to LAST in steps of INCR.

commands.name: HELP (APPT)
commands.description: Shows the formats for an appointment's date and time.

commands.name: HELP (SET)
commands.description: Shows how to key in the date and the time.

commands.name: HMS(t)
commands.description: In an equation: hours with a decimal fraction turned into HH.MMSS.

commands.name: HOUR
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many hours (the number shown).

commands.name: HRS(t)
commands.description: In an equation: a time in HH.MMSS turned into hours with a decimal fraction.

commands.name: I% (CFLO)
commands.description: The interest rate per period used for NPV, NUS and NFV (cost of capital, discount rate).

commands.name: I%YR
commands.description: The nominal yearly interest rate, in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: ICNV
commands.description: Interest conversion: between nominal and effective yearly rates, for periodic or continuous compounding.

commands.name: IDIV(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the whole-number part of x divided by y.

commands.name: IF(cond:then:else)
commands.description: In an equation: the value of then when cond is true, else the value of else. Conditions use = < > ≤ ≥ ≠ and AND, OR, XOR, NOT.

commands.name: INCR
commands.description: How many payments each line of the printed table covers.

commands.name: INPUT
commands.description: Enters the number or text typed: an item into a SUM or CFLO list, an equation into the Solver, or an answer to a prompt.

commands.name: INSR (CFLO)
commands.description: Inserts a flow before the one shown.

commands.name: INSR (SUM)
commands.description: Inserts an item before the one shown.

commands.name: INT (AMRT)
commands.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to interest.

commands.name: INT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the largest whole number not above x.

commands.name: INTL
commands.description: Opens a menu to choose the language of the messages and labels.

commands.name: INV(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 1/x.

commands.name: IP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the integer part of x, its fraction dropped.

commands.name: IRR%
commands.description: The internal rate of return per period: the discount rate that makes NPV of the flows zero.

commands.name: ITEM(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: item number n of the named SUM list.

commands.name: LAST
commands.description: Copies the last result into the calculator line, to use it again.

commands.name: LAST (TABLE)
commands.description: The last payment of the table to print.

commands.name: LIFE
commands.description: The useful life in whole years.

commands.name: LIN
commands.description: Fits a straight line, y = B + M·x.

commands.name: LIST
commands.description: Prints the values of the menu on display, or the current SUM or CFLO list, or the appointments in the APPT menu.

commands.name: LN
commands.description: The natural (base e) logarithm of the number shown.

commands.name: LN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of x.

commands.name: LNP1(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of 1 + x, exact for small x.

commands.name: LOG
commands.description: The common (base 10) logarithm of the number shown.

commands.name: LOG (FRCST)
commands.description: Fits a logarithmic curve, y = B + M·ln x.

commands.name: LOG(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the base-10 logarithm of x.

commands.name: M
commands.description: The M coefficient of the chosen model; the slope for the linear one.

commands.name: M%C
commands.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of COST. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: M%P
commands.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of PRICE. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: M/D
commands.description: Switches the date format from month/day/year to day.month.year and back.

commands.name: MAIN
commands.description: Goes straight back to the MAIN menu from any menu.

commands.name: MAT
commands.description: The maturity date, or the call date (which must be a coupon date).

commands.name: MATH
commands.description: Opens the MATH menu: logarithms, powers of 10 and e, factorial and π.

commands.name: MAX
commands.description: The biggest number of the list.

commands.name: MAX(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the larger of x and y.

commands.name: MEAN
commands.description: The average (arithmetic mean) of the list.

commands.name: MEDN
commands.description: The median of the list.

commands.name: MEM
commands.description: Shows how many bytes of memory are free, and what percentage that is.

commands.name: MIN (RPT)
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many minutes (the number shown).

commands.name: MIN (SUM)
commands.description: The smallest value of the list.

commands.name: MIN(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the smaller of x and y.

commands.name: MOD(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the remainder of x divided by y, x − y·INT(x/y).

commands.name: MODES
commands.description: Opens the MODES menu: the beeper, the printer's power and the display language.

commands.name: MODL
commands.description: Opens the choice of curve-fitting model: LIN, LOG, EXP, PWR.

commands.name: MORE (BOND)
commands.description: The second BOND menu: YLD%, PRICE, ACCRU.

commands.name: MORE (DEPRC)
commands.description: The second DEPRC menu: YR#, FACT% and the three methods.

commands.name: MORE (SUM CALC)
commands.description: The second CALC menu: MIN, MAX, SORT, FRCST.

commands.name: MSG (APPT)
commands.description: Types or shows the appointment's message with the ALPHA menu.

commands.name: MSG (PRINTER)
commands.description: Types a message of up to 22 characters with the ALPHA menu and prints it, to label a printout.

commands.name: MU%C
commands.description: Markup on cost: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%C.

commands.name: MU%P
commands.description: Markup on price: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%P.

commands.name: N
commands.description: How many payments or compounding periods there are. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the others. ⇧ N stores the number shown times P/YR (years to payments).

commands.name: N!
commands.description: The factorial of the number shown, a whole number from 0 to 253.

commands.name: NAME (CFLO)
commands.description: Names or renames the current cash-flow list.

commands.name: NAME (SUM)
commands.description: Names or renames the current SUM list.

commands.name: NEW (%CHG)
commands.description: The new value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from OLD and %CH.

commands.name: NEW (SOLVE)
commands.description: Starts a new equation: type it with the ALPHA menu and the keyboard, then press INPUT.

commands.name: NEXT
commands.description: Works out the next schedule of #P payments.

commands.name: NFV
commands.description: The net future value: NPV carried forward to the last period at I%.

commands.name: NOM% (CONT)
commands.description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded continuously. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

commands.name: NOM% (PER)
commands.description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded P times a year. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

commands.name: NONE
commands.description: The appointment does not repeat.

commands.name: NOT
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when what follows is false.

commands.name: NPV
commands.description: NPV of the cash flows at the rate I%: their net present value.

commands.name: NUS
commands.description: The net uniform series: the equal flow per period whose present value equals NPV.

commands.name: OFF
commands.description: Turns the calculator off. Continuous memory keeps everything.

commands.name: OLD
commands.description: The old value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NEW and %CH.

commands.name: OR
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when either side is true.

commands.name: OTHER (TVM)
commands.description: The second TVM menu: payments per year, begin or end mode, amortisation.

commands.name: P
commands.description: How many times a year interest is compounded.

commands.name: P/YR
commands.description: Sets how many payments there are per year, 1 to 999.

commands.name: PART
commands.description: The share of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: PER
commands.description: Periodic compounding: the menu of NOM%, EFF% and P.

commands.name: PI
commands.description: In an equation: π, 3.14159265359.

commands.name: PMT
commands.description: The amount of each equal payment. Money paid out is negative. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: PRICE (BOND)
commands.description: The price per 100 of face value. Stores the number shown, or works it out from YLD%.

commands.name: PRICE (MU%C)
commands.description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%C.

commands.name: PRICE (MU%P)
commands.description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%P.

commands.name: PRIN
commands.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to principal.

commands.name: PRINTER
commands.description: Opens the PRINTER menu: print the current menu's values or list, the stack, the registers, the time or a message.

commands.name: PRNT
commands.description: Tells the calculator whether the printer runs on its AC adapter (it then prints faster) or on batteries.

commands.name: PRT
commands.description: Prints what the display shows on the infrared printer.

commands.name: PV
commands.description: The present value: the loan amount or the first investment, at the start of the first period. Money paid out is negative.

commands.name: PWR
commands.description: Fits a power curve, y = B·x^M.

commands.name: RANG
commands.description: The biggest number of the list less the smallest.

commands.name: RCL
commands.description: Recalls a register (then a digit 0-9) or the value of a menu variable (then its menu key) into the calculator line, without calculating it.

commands.name: REGS
commands.description: Prints registers 0 to 9.

commands.name: RND(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: x rounded to y places after the point (y from 0 to 11), or to −y significant digits (y from −12 to −1).

commands.name: RPT
commands.description: Shows how often the appointment repeats and opens the menu to change it.

commands.name: S(var)
commands.description: In an equation: true when the Solver is solving for var. With IF it puts several related equations into one menu.

commands.name: SALV
commands.description: The salvage value left when the asset's life ends (0 if none).

commands.name: SEMI
commands.description: Coupons are paid twice a year.

commands.name: SET
commands.description: Opens the menu that sets the date and time and their formats.

commands.name: SETT
commands.description: The settlement (purchase) date, keyed in the date format in use.

commands.name: SGN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 1 when x is positive, 0 when it is zero, −1 when it is negative.

commands.name: SHOW
commands.description: Shows the number with all its 12 digits while the key is held.

commands.name: SIZE
commands.description: How many items each of the two lists holds.

commands.name: SIZEC(list)
commands.description: In an equation: the number of the final flow of the named CFLO list.

commands.name: SIZES(list)
commands.description: In an equation: how many items the named SUM list holds.

commands.name: SL
commands.description: Depreciation by the straight-line method for the year in YR#.

commands.name: SOLVE
commands.description: Opens the Solver: type your own equations and solve them for any variable.

commands.name: SORT
commands.description: Sorts the list from the smallest number up.

commands.name: SOYD
commands.description: Depreciation by the sum-of-the-years'-digits method for the year in YR#.

commands.name: SPFV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: what 1 paid now is worth after n periods at i% per period, (1 + i%/100)^n.

commands.name: SPPV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: what 1 paid after n periods at i% per period is worth now, 1/SPFV(i%:n).

commands.name: SQ(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x squared.

commands.name: SQRT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the square root of x.

commands.name: STDEV
commands.description: The sample standard deviation of the list.

commands.name: STK
commands.description: Prints the history stack.

commands.name: STO
commands.description: Stores the number shown: then press a digit 0-9 for a register or a menu key for a variable. STO + − × ÷ before the register does the arithmetic in it.

commands.name: SUM
commands.description: Opens SUM: lists of numbers, their running total and statistics.

commands.name: TABLE
commands.description: Opens the printing of an amortisation table: type the number of the final payment to print, then press START.

commands.name: TIME
commands.description: Shows the date and time and opens the TIME menu: date arithmetic, appointments, adjusting and setting the clock.

commands.name: TIME (APPT)
commands.description: Sets the appointment's time to the time shown (HH.MM); a past date becomes today.

commands.name: TIME (PRINTER)
commands.description: Prints the date and time.

commands.name: TIME (SET)
commands.description: Sets the time to the number shown (HH.MMSS).

commands.name: TODAY
commands.description: Puts today's date into the calculator line, to store in DATE1 or DATE2.

commands.name: TOTAL (%TOTL)
commands.description: The whole amount, of which PART is a share. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: TOTAL (CFLO)
commands.description: All the cash flows of the list added up.

commands.name: TOTAL (SUM CALC)
commands.description: All the numbers of the list added up.

commands.name: TOTAL (SUM)
commands.description: Shows the total of the items in the list.

commands.name: TRACE
commands.description: Turns trace printing on or off: with it on, every calculation is printed as it is done.

commands.name: TRN(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: x cut off (not rounded) to y decimal places, or to −y significant digits when y is negative.

commands.name: TVM
commands.description: Time value of money: works out loans, savings, leases and their amortisation from the five values N, I%YR, PV, PMT, FV.

commands.name: TYPE
commands.description: Opens the menu of bond types: calendar and coupon frequency.

commands.name: USFV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the future value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

commands.name: USPV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the present value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

commands.name: W.MN
commands.description: The mean of the x values weighted by the y list.

commands.name: WEEK
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many weeks (the number shown).

commands.name: XOR
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when exactly one side is true.

commands.name: YLD%
commands.description: The yearly yield in percent, to maturity or to the call date. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE.

commands.name: YR#
commands.description: The year to depreciate: 1, 2 and so on.

commands.name: x²
commands.description: The square of the number shown.

commands.name: yˣ
commands.description: Raises the number before it to the power of the next one: 2 yˣ 3 = 8.
Multiplies the number before it by the next one.
Divides the number before it by the next one.

commands.name: Σ(ctr:c1:c2:s:expr)
commands.description: In an equation: the sum of expr as the counter ctr runs from c1 to c2 in steps of s.

commands.name: ΣX
commands.description: The sum of the x list.

commands.name: ΣX2
commands.description: The x values squared and added up.

commands.name: ΣXY
commands.description: Each x times its y, added up.

commands.name: ΣY
commands.description: The sum of the y list.

commands.name: ΣY2
commands.description: The y values squared and added up.
Subtracts the next number from the one before it.

commands.name: √x
commands.description: The square root of the number shown.
Rolls the history stack up one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the previous item or equation.
Rolls the history stack down one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the next item or equation.
Backspace: erases the last character typed, or the whole number when no cursor shows.
